# fluent_sqflite

> A model-driven database layer for Flutter on top of sqflite: declare a model (FluentStorable) and its table
> (FluentProvider); the library creates and migrates the schema, loads relations in batches, keeps a soft-delete
> trash, streams live queries, pages with cursors, syncs with servers and explains every error with a code and a hint.
> Version 2.0.0. Never write SQL for model tables; raw SQL (rawQuery / execute) is only an escape hatch.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): install, quick start (model → provider → FluentDb.init → save / find / watch / findPage)
- [AI overview and rules](doc/ai/README.md): the ten rules, which skill to use when
- [AGENTS.md snippet](doc/ai/agents-snippet.md): rules to paste into a project

## Agent skills (install: dart run skills@ get -p fluent_sqflite)

- [Models](skills/fluent-sqflite-models/SKILL.md): FluentStorable, FluentProvider, keys, column types and options, enums, converters, expiry, mixins
- [Setup and lifecycle](skills/fluent-sqflite-setup/SKILL.md): FluentDb.init, FluentGroup, FluentConfig / FluentDbConfig (pragmas) / FluentTableConfig, diagnostics and tuner, ExecutionPolicy, pauseQueue, close / restart / deleteDatabases
- [Reading](skills/fluent-sqflite-queries/SKILL.md): find, FluentFilter, relation filters, search, aggregates, findPage / FluentCursor, watch, rawQuery
- [Writing](skills/fluent-sqflite-writes/SKILL.md): save strategies, FluentSaveResult, conflictOn, updates, soft delete, transactions, clear
- [Relations](skills/fluent-sqflite-relations/SKILL.md): one, oneOwned, many, manyToMany, through, oneOf, auto, relations found in buildJson, loading, attach / detach
- [Schema changes](skills/fluent-sqflite-schema/SKILL.md): automatic sync, FluentDbMigration, archive, quarantine, planMigrations / onMigrationPlan, schemaReport
- [Sync](skills/fluent-sqflite-sync/SKILL.md): watchRemote, FluentSyncable push / pull, conflicts, server keys, remote deletes, tombstones, watchSyncStatus
- [Testing](skills/fluent-sqflite-testing/SKILL.md): fluent_sqflite_test (FluentTestDb, db.clock, db.settle, issues), benchmark
- [Troubleshooting](skills/fluent-sqflite-troubleshooting/SKILL.md): FluentErrorCode, FluentIssue kinds, logging, report, performance
- [Upgrading](skills/fluent-sqflite-upgrade/SKILL.md): renamed / removed members and how to rewrite them

## Reference
